items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Raymond Blount would play drum while I eat.

ctx.x: Well, they gave you a lot of rest there, didn't they? Rest? What rest? Rest! Did you hear the man say a Jitney dance? Yeah. Rest. Lord, have fun.

Man, man. Boy, I was young, I could take it. From 8 to 4, 5 on Sunday mornings, 5 and 6. That's right. Mardi Gras Day from 9 to 3 and 4 the next Ash Wednesday. Oh, that was it. We'd get a break break from about 6 to 7, 30, Mardi Gras Day. It was a break to get something to eat. One guy had to go eat at the time, you know. You see the sandwich and trumpet players, man. Raymond Blount would play drum while I eat. He'd jump on the piano, play a little piano. He's a nice arranger. He'd play a little piano while Lewis…
Was it a tough place too? Or any fights? We had a police. Oh, yeah.
